CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW v_us_food_cuur0000saf1_yoyv2_ex20261028_003921_2475718 WITH CONTAINER psig AS
SELECT 'US' AS country, 'food' AS concept, 'CUUR0000SAF1' AS category_code, 'Food' AS category_label,
       'M' AS frequency, period,
       CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(period, 1, 4) AS INT) - CAST(SUBSTR(previous_period, 1, 4) AS INT) = 1
                  AND previous_idx > 0
            THEN ROUND(100.0 * (idx / previous_idx - 1), 2) END AS yoy_pct,
       'bls:CU:CUUR0000SAF1' AS source_id
FROM (
  SELECT period, idx,
         LAG(idx, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY SUBSTR(period, 6) ORDER BY period) AS previous_idx,
         LAG(period, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY SUBSTR(period, 6) ORDER BY period) AS previous_period
  FROM (
  SELECT CONCAT(d.year, '-', SUBSTR(d.period, 2, 2)) AS period, CAST(d.value AS DOUBLE) AS idx
  FROM psig_bls.bls_us_cuur0000saf1_ex20261028_003921_2475718
  LATERAL VIEW explode(Results.series) AS s
  LATERAL VIEW explode(s.data) AS d
  WHERE d.period LIKE 'M%' AND d.period <> 'M13'
  ) decoded
) b

       CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(period, 1, 4) AS INT) - CAST(SUBSTR(previous_period, 1, 4) AS INT) = 1
                  AND previous_idx > 0
            THEN ROUND(100.0 * (idx / previous_idx - 1), 2) END AS yoy_pct,
       'bls:CU:CUUR0000SA0' AS source_id
FROM (
  SELECT period, idx,
         LAG(idx, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY SUBSTR(period, 6) ORDER BY period) AS previous_idx,
         LAG(period, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY SUBSTR(period, 6) ORDER BY period) AS previous_period
  FROM (
  SELECT CONCAT(d.year, '-', SUBSTR(d.period, 2, 2)) AS period, CAST(d.value AS DOUBLE) AS idx
  FROM psig_bls.bls_us_cuur0000sa0_ex20261028_003921_2475718
  LATERAL VIEW explode(Results.series) AS s
  LATERAL VIEW explode(s.data) AS d
  WHERE d.period LIKE 'M%' AND d.period <> 'M13'
  ) decoded
) b
CACHE TABLE psig_bls.bls_us_cuur0000sa0_ex20261028_003921_2475718
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(period) AS latest FROM psig.v_us_all_items_cuur0000sa0_yoyv2_ex20261028_003921_2475718 WHERE yoy_pct IS NOT NULL

SELECT p.sku, p.product, p.country, p.sku_category, p.currency, p.current_price, s.concept AS rate_concept, s.category_label, s.frequency, s.period, s.yoy_pct, s.source_id
FROM psig.v_price_list_ex20261028_003921_2475718 p
JOIN (
    SELECT country, concept, category_label, frequency, period, yoy_pct, source_id FROM psig.v_ca_condiments_v41690974_live_yoyv2_ex20261028_003921_2475718 WHERE yoy_pct IS NOT NULL AND period >= '2025-07'
